summary: Redwire Corp filed an 8-K to disclose entry into an at-the-market equity distribution agreement allowing sale of up to $500 million of its common stock through multiple agents. The filing details mechanics of ATM sales, commission structure, and intended use of proceeds for working capital, debt repayment, acquisitions, and R&D. No special-situation event exists; this is a routine capital-raising program, not a transformative transaction or activist campaign. The filing carries no board recommendation, premium, or structural complexity typical of special situations.
